decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order), and notwithstanding what is shown on the submitted drawing (013/05/A), no new means of access from the premises to the highway shall be formed, laid out and constructed.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension, single storey rear extension and front entrance porch to house
